info.title: MACsec_KaY_MKA_Peer
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

is_keyserver.description: Specifies whether this peer is the current key server entity.

keyserver_priority.description: Key-server priority associated with the MKA peer.

macsec_capability.description: MACsec capability supported by the MKA peer.  `no_macsec`:               does not support MACsec.  `ic_only`:                 supports integrity check without                             confidentiality.  `ic_and_conf`:             supports integrity check and                             confidentiality with offset 0.  `ic_and_conf_with_offset`: supports integrity check and                             confidentiality with offset 0, 30                             and 50.

member_identifier.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_KaY_MKA_Peer](#/MACsec_KaY_MKA_Peer)
Member identifier associated with the MKA peer.

message_number.description: Message Number (MN) associated with the MKA peer.

peer_type.description: The type of the MKA peer.  `live`:      Represents an active MKA peer attached to this MKA               participant.  `potential`: Represents a potential MKA peer corresponding to               this MKA participant

receive_sc.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Channel](#/MACsec_Secure_Channel)
Receive SC(s) associated with the MKA peer.

sci.description: Secure Channel Identifier (SCI) associated with the MKA peer.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
The interface name. For non-bonded ports, the interface name is the same as the associated port name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: MACsec_SecY.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_SecY](#/MACsec_SecY)
The identifier associated with the SecY.

parameters.name: MACsec_KaY_MKA.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_KaY_MKA](#/MACsec_KaY_MKA)
MACSec Key Agreement Entity associated with this SecY.

parameters.name: MACsec_KaY_MKA_Participant.ckn
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_KaY_MKA_Participant](#/MACsec_KaY_MKA_Participant)
MKA instances running on this KaY, one for each Connectivity Association Key Name (CKN).

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
